# Stepper (`stepper`)

− value + for small counts.

Group: Choice & range. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/choice-inputs';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createStepper` (types in `dist/web/choice-inputs/stepper.d.ts`): `.mh-stepper`: − value + for small counts. The value is a focusable `role="spinbutton"` (arrow keys, Page Up/Down, Home/End); the buttons are for pointer and touch and stay out of the Tab order, as in the ARIA spinbutton pattern. A button disables at its limit.

```ts
export function createStepper(options: StepperOptions): StepperHandle;

export interface StepperOptions {
  /** Accessible name of the value (the spinbutton). */
  label: string;
  value?: number;
  min?: number;
  max?: number;
  step?: number;
  /** Formats the shown and spoken value (e.g. `v => v + ' people'`). */
  format?: (value: number) => string;
  size?: 'small' | 'medium';
  disabled?: boolean;
  decreaseLabel?: string;
  increaseLabel?: string;
  onChange?: (value: number) => void;
}

export interface StepperHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  /** The focusable value (`role="spinbutton"`). */
  spinbutton: HTMLSpanElement;
  getValue(): number;
  setValue(value: number): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createStepper } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const status = document.createElement('p');
const guests = createStepper({
  label: 'Guests',
  value: 2,
  min: 1,
  max: 8,
  format: (v) => (v === 1 ? '1 guest' : `${v} guests`),
  onChange: (value) => (status.textContent = `Guest mode for ${value}`),
});

document.body.append(guests.el, status);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Stepper } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

export function StepperExample() {
  const [guests, setGuests] = useState(2);
  return (
    <Stepper
      label="Guests"
      min={1}
      max={8}
      format={(v) => (v === 1 ? '1 guest' : `${v} guests`)}
      value={guests}
      onChange={setGuests}
    />
  );
}
```
